description: This file defines the class ViewSugarFieldCollection, which manages the display and processing of collection fields within the SuiteCRM framework. It handles retrieving related data, preparing display parameters, rendering templates, and managing quick search & popup functionalities for collection-type fields in forms.

classes.name: ViewSugarFieldCollection
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering and managing collection fields in SuiteCRM, including setup of relationships, retrieval of data, rendering templates, and handling quick search and popup interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, decodes display parameters and vardef from request if $fill_data is true, sets up internal variables.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Establishes relationships between modules, loads beans and related data based on vardef, ensuring correct module relationships.

methods.name: retrieve_values
methods.description: Retrieves related records from the database and populates the bean’s value array for display.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Delegates to editview or detailview processing based on action_type.

methods.name: process_detailview
methods.description: Placeholder for handling detail view processing (currently no implementation).

methods.name: process_editview
methods.description: Prepares display parameters, manages collection field list, handles JavaScript for related fields, and configures template rendering specifics.

methods.name: init_tpl
methods.description: Initializes Smarty template object with assigned variables, choosing templates based on view type.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered template for the collection field, caching the output if necessary.

methods.name: checkTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a cached template exists and whether to regenerate it based on development mode.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript or array data for quick search functionality in collection fields, based on related module type.

methods.name: createPopupCode
methods.description: Prepares the popup data request parameters for selecting related records.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Locates the appropriate Smarty template file for a given view, considering current language and customizations.
